_comment: Group attack distributed mode demo: box-select three player regiments (Spearmen/Infantry/Archers, seed 12345 y=300), press X to switch from focused to distributed attack, then right-click the enemy Spearmen at (452,880). Each selected unit automatically targets a different nearby enemy instead of all piling onto one. The HUD flashes 'Attack: distributed' when X is pressed.

overlap.reason: Enemy cavalry (uid8) on the default 5v5 compresses below the cavalry overlap floor while the player's distributed attack runs. Pre-existing on main; owned by in-flight melee/spacing work, not this spawn-pin retarget.
